title: Room Reservations Late Cancellation Share by Days Before Arrival
content:
**Schedule clause.** The penalty a late cancellation of a Room Reservations reservation owes is a share of the penalty night that depends on how many days before arrival the cancellation was recorded. When the cancellation was recorded at least 2 days before the arrival date, counted in calendar days from the date of the cancellation to the arrival date, the penalty owed is the early-late share of 50% of the penalty night; when it was recorded at least 1 day but fewer than 2 days before arrival, it is the eve share of 75%; a cancellation recorded on the arrival date pays the full share of 100%.

**Counting.** Only calendar dates are compared: the date of the recorded cancellation moment, in hotel local time, and the arrival date on the reservation. The hour of the cancellation plays no part in this count.

| Calendar days from the cancellation date to the arrival date | Share of the penalty night |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 50% |
| 1 | 75% |
| 0 (cancelled on the arrival date) | 100% |

**Cases (hypothetical arrival on 20 June).**

| Cancellation recorded | Days counted | Share |
|---|---|---|
| 17 June, 10:15 | 3 | 50% |
| 18 June, 23:58 | 2 | 50% |
| 19 June, 00:05 | 1 | 75% |
| 20 June, 14:00 | 0 | 100% |

On a hypothetical penalty night of 220.00, the shares come to 110.00, 165.00 and 220.00 respectively, before room tax.
